text:
This looks like a salad bowl with mixed greens, red onion, avocado slices, and cubed chicken or tofu. The bowl is probably about 20 cm across, so I treated it as a larger salad bowl rather than the 15 cm size.

Weight estimate:
- About 20 cubes of chicken or tofu at roughly 12 g each comes to about 150 g.
- Greens come to about 60 g.
- Avocado, perhaps half a fruit, comes to about 60 g.
- Onion and other extras come to about 10 g.
- Total is about 280 g.

Energy estimate:
- Chicken at about 1.6 kcal/g gives about 240 kcal. Tofu would be lower, around 150 kcal, so I took roughly 200 kcal.
- Avocado at 1.6 kcal/g gives about 95 kcal.
- Greens and onion add about 20 kcal.
- Visible oil or seasoning adds about 30 kcal.
- Total is about 345 kcal, which I rounded to 340.
